title: 03 Guitar

blocks.text: The guitar is a fretted chordophone — six strings standard (E-A-D-G-B-E low to high), though seven, eight, and twelve-string variants exist. Origins trace to medieval lute family; modern classical guitar crystallised in 19th-century Spain.
Classical (nylon strings, fingerstyle). Steel-string acoustic (folk, country). Electric (magnetic pickups, amplification). Resonator (Dobro) for slide. Flamenco guitar — lighter, tap plate.
Right hand: fingerpicking (p-i-m-a) or plectrum. Left hand: frets fix pitch; barre chords across strings. Capo transposes open shapes.
Backing chords in sessions; DADGAD and open tunings for Celtic accompaniment. Flatpicking for reels; fingerstyle for airs.

sections.title: Q1. Standard guitar string tuning includes:

blocks.text:
- A) E-A-D-G-B-E
- B) G-D-A-E only
- C) C-F-A-D
- D) D-A-D-A

**Answer:** A

sections.title: Q2. Guitar is a fretted chordophone.

blocks.text:
- A) An alternate tuning used in Celtic guitar
- B) A type of drum
- C) A piano pedal
- D) A vocal technique

**Answer:** A

quiz_markdown:
### Q1. Standard guitar string tuning includes:

- A) E-A-D-G-B-E
- B) G-D-A-E only
- C) C-F-A-D
- D) D-A-D-A

**Answer:** A

### Q2. Guitar is a fretted chordophone.

**Answer:** True

### Q3. DADGAD is:

- A) An alternate tuning used in Celtic guitar
- B) A type of drum
- C) A piano pedal
- D) A vocal technique

**Answer:** A
